body:
使用这个角色，生成一张GIF图，内容是她吃大白米饭，图片里有文字：真香！

【制作适配：本次输出】上文只定义动作和造型。本次只输出一张PNG精灵图，严格4列×2行，共8格，左到右、上到下按时间排列，每格同样大小。不是GIF文件。不要边框、格线、边距、序号、时间码；除指定字幕外不要新增文字。所有格固定机位、角色大小、地面基线和配色，角色和动作不超出单格。连续帧有清晰不同的姿态，之后逐格编码为GIF。
8格动作：端碗、夹饭、抬筷、送入口、咀嚼、满足微笑、再夹饭、回到端碗。每格顶部固定准确中文“真香！”。

en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R08), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Generate one PNG sheet, extract 8 cells in row-major order, and encode them with the recorded delays and loop setting. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

8 frames, 2 seconds, 443×443px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Eight chest-up frames show holding rice, lifting chopsticks, eating, chewing and a satisfied smile, with correct 真香！ lettering throughout. Blue whale maid features follow reference. Two-second repeating GIF; slight redrawn subtitle and hair movement remains.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@Gorden_Sun's original prompt](https://x.com/Gorden_Sun/status/2118166046175908016). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

按显示顺序上传 1 张本站生成的参考图（R08），使用完整改编词。

先生成单张 PNG 精灵图，按行优先提取 8 格，以记录的停留时长和循环设置编码为 GIF。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

8 帧，2 秒，443×443 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

端碗、夹饭、入口、咀嚼和微笑动作明确，各格“真香！”正确，存在轻微重绘抖动。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@Gorden_Sun 的原词](https://x.com/Gorden_Sun/status/2118166046175908016)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
